primary_use: retrieval-ready domain memory for AI assistants, local Atlas systems, agents, workflow copilots, Gradio apps, and ComfyUI helper layers
core_principle: Master principles, not platforms. Tools change. Principles transfer.
source_priority: canonical lanes > Atlas cards > user expanded notes > canonical source packs > raw provenance archives > legacy superseded material
source_preservation_policy: Source-backed material is preserved for provenance. Structure and brand passes may de-prioritize or reword control-layer material, but do not remove domain evidence.
source_integrity_policy: Use web verification for current/volatile model, tool, benchmark, hardware, license, API, and package-status claims unless explicitly opted out by the user.
anti_slop_policy: No unsourced AI-written research claim is canonical; fabricated or unverified citations must be quarantined, qualified, or removed from canonical answers.
do_not_index_by_default: source inventories unless doing provenance review
do_not_overclaim: all included fast-moving claims are current forever
current_focus: evaluation harness proof testing and raw-RAG comparison
force_multiplier_policy: AI is leverage, not replacement; the human supplies goal, judgment, values, taste, and final decision.
humor_policy: Use dry AIWF field-manual humor to reduce fear and aid learning; never use humor to soften source, safety, consent, license, privacy, or destructive-command warnings.
brand_alignment_policy: Apply AIWF_BRAND_ROLE_MAP.md after retrieval/source gates. Voice never outranks evidence. Humor is blocked in source, legal, safety, security, and manifest contexts.
workflow_prompt_brand_pass: v2.9 focused on provided workflow prompts, default prompts, markdown guidance, and Torchie personality boundaries

torchie_rebrand.rule: Use 2026 rebrand Torchie for new visual assets and prompt callouts.

active_history_policy: versioned control artifacts are archived in 06_CHANGE_HISTORY and not active ingestion targets
